note:
R19 rev. 2 — dasher-board ads (PS4 15–21): the typed-reference structures in `gccollections` around `<arena>_rink_boards`, kept
separate from name associations and from any inferred consumer.

Parsed (typed RefSpec pointers, resolved against the vault's record index):
  ge_model `<arena>_rink_boards.mcd` -> material RefSpec array `962826a5` (`u16 n | u16 n | u32 16 | n x (RefSpec, 8 zero)`) -> ge_material
  (DebugName `boards_ads_mat_<N>` and others) -> `Effect` record -> ge_texture FileRefs (every ad material: shared `boards_ads_base_*`,
  `boards_ads_damage_diff`, and the `8aab7882` slot = `boards_ads_decal_alpha_diff`).
  ge_gameobject (name attr `dc0edb22` = `<arena>_rink_boards`) -> `Schema` -> ge_scene_schema -> component RefSpec array ->
  ge_scene_runtimetexturecomponent (`7968c7b3` = RefSpec array of ge_texture; `de04fabd` parallel Text array, null) and
  ge_scene_runtimetextureoverridecomponent (`ImageGroup` = RefSpec array of ge_imagegroup); ge_imagegroup (`ArenaId`, `BoardVariation`,
  `GameMode`, `MatchType` enums + `7968c7b3` RefSpec array of ge_texture).
Name associations (no pointer): gameobject name <-> ge_instance DebugName <-> stadium folder / model FileRef <-> ge_level DebugName.
Measured but NOT a traced consumer: the runtimetexturecomponent array length equals the model's ad-slot count (+1 on NHL 21); the
element-i -> material-slot-i reading is a candidate interpretation only. ge_imagegroup element order and the mapping of short groups
onto panels are unresolved. Also censused: `adboard_*` materials (building signage) -> the ge_model records whose material arrays
reference them (sharers). Read-only. Usage: python r19_board_materials.py <out.json>
